title: Design Your Dream - Be Your Own Entrepreneur Hackathon for 3D Product Design - March 2025
description: This individual participation hackathon is a platform for designers, engineers, students, and innovators to bring their creative 3D-printable product ideas to life. Participants will have the opportunity to design, develop, and showcase functional and industry-relevant 3D models while pushing the boundaries of innovation, usability, and design feasibility
detail: The hackathon is designed to drive innovation and creativity in 3D-printed product design by providing a structured platform for participants to conceptualize, design, and develop unique, functional, and technologically advanced 3D-Modelling. It encourages independent thinkers—including designers, engineers, hobbyists, and innovators—to push the boundaries of usability, efficient in 3D printing. As an individual participation event, the hackathon challenges each participant to showcase their problem-solving abilities, technical expertise, and creative vision. It fosters a collaborative learning environment where individuals engage in knowledge-sharing, hands-on experimentation, and real-world application of 3D design and additive manufacturing technologies. The outcomes of this hackathon will contribute to practical, scalable, and industry-relevant 3D-printed solutions applicable across multiple sectors.
bannerTitle: Design Your Dream - Be Your Own Entrepreneur Hackathon for 3D Product Design
